messages:
Ana: quick Q — onboarding ACME for customer-scoped flag `new-routing-v2`. contract says feature must be gated to ACME only. what's the minimal safe rollout checklist?

Praveen: +1. checklist I usually run through: 1) create per-customer flag (customer:acme) 2) update contract->feature mapping in billing service 3) add ACME to allowlist in flags service 4) set canary to 1% + health alerts 5) set hard fallback to v1 + quota guardrails.

Marta: add step 0: confirm db migration compatibility. we had a schema edgecase last month.

Sam: for the allowlist entry, use the customer internal id not external slug. pinging @ana for ACME id.

Ana: ACME id is `cust_9842`. pls use that.

Praveen: example flag config I pushed to staging (yaml):
```yaml
flag: customer:new-routing-v2
customer_id: "cust_9842"
scope:
  type: allowlist
rollout:
  canary_pct: 1
  ramp: 1 -> 5 over 24h (manual)
guardrails:
  fallback: new-routing-v1
  rate_limit_per_min: 12000
  health_checks:
    - latency_p95: "<= 200ms"
    - error_rate: "< 0.1%"
monitoring:
  alerts:
    - name: ff_newrouting_high_error
      query: "error_rate > 0.2% for 5m"
      notify: #eng-oncall, #eng-platform
```

Jen: small UX note — when flag is customer-scoped the console shows `customer-only` badge. can you add the contract id to the metadata so CSMs see the linkage?

Praveen: yep I can add contract_id tag. will do before we flip staging -> canary.

Sam: ops checklist for rollout:
- create flag in prod with state=off
- add allowlist entry
- create canary policy (1%) + set auto-fallback to off if alerts fire
- set ephemeral log level for routing component to DEBUG for first hour
- create short-lived dashboard (1h window) for ACME traffic
- schedule a 30m post-canary check in calendar

Ana: who wants to own the first flip to 1% in prod? I can do it but would prefer someone from runtime team to watch infra metrics.

Marta: I can watch infra for the first 30m. assign to me and cc @sam for dashboard ops.

Praveen: I'll do the flag creation + contract tag. tagging the runbook: https://internal.redwood/ops/ff-onboarding (see section "Enterprise contract gating").

featureflag-bot: Created flag `customer:new-routing-v2` (ff_789) in staging by Praveen. Audit id: audit_2026_4432.

Ana: perfect. TL;DR owners: Praveen = create & tag, Marta = infra watch, Sam = dashboard & rollback ops, Jen = CSM visibility. I'll schedule the 30m check for 2026-03-18 16:00 PT. :thumbsup:

Praveen: will push the contract mapping and prod flag as ``state: off`` today. will post the prod flip thread when ready.

Sam: note to oncall — please expect an alert routing spike if ACME sends a retry storm during canary. pre-set silence window for non-critical noisey alerts.

Ana: thanks all — keep the updates in this thread.
